job.title: Intern Software Development Engineering R&D (AI/ML/NLP), Graduation Year

tailored_resume_bullets: Developed a production-ready tours and travel management system using Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Built a full-stack trading platform (Zenvest) featuring an Express API, MongoDB Atlas, and JWT-based authentication using httpOnly cookies.
Engineered DriftGuard, a MERN-stack security control drift detection tool with MongoDB Atlas, deployed end-to-end within a hackathon timeline.
Implemented server-side request validation with Joi schemas and centralized error handling via custom Express middleware in the StaySphere project.
kit.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Intern Software Development Engineering R&D (AI/ML/NLP) position at viscr ai. As an MCA student at PES University with a CGPA of 8.48 and hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute my backend and programming skills to your engineering team.

My technical background includes working with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Java, and SQL. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready management system using Node.js, Express, and MySQL that is currently live for real customer bookings. Additionally, my project experience includes building scalable backend applications like Zenvest, a trading platform clone with an Express API and MongoDB, and DriftGuard, a MERN-stack application built during a Société Générale hackathon.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it offers the opportunity to transition into a full-time position after a 6-month internship. I am comfortable working in Bangalore and am ready to bring my dedication, solid foundation in computer science, and practical development skills to viscr ai.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Amaanuddin Ahmed

screening_answers.why_this_company: viscr ai offers an exciting opportunity to work on software development engineering and R&D, with a clear path from a 6-month internship to a full-time role.
screening_answers.why_this_role: This role aligns with my background in computer science, software development, and my familiarity with languages and technologies like Node.js, Python, Java, and SQL.
screening_answers.why_you: I am currently pursuing my MCA at PES University with an 8.48 CGPA and have practical experience building backend systems and web applications using Node.js, Express, Python, Java, and SQL through my internship and academic projects.
screening_answers.availability: Available immediately for a 6-month internship leading to a full-time role.
screening_answers.expected_stipend: INR 25,000/month or as per company standards.
screening_answers.relocation: Yes, I am based in Bengaluru and open to working locally.
screening_answers.relevant_technology_experience: I have hands-on experience with Node.js, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and SQL through academic projects, my internship at Sunflower Trip, and freelance work.

application_strategy: Highlight backend development experience with Node.js, Java, and Python prominently on the resume.
Emphasize the 6-month internship to full-time conversion alignment in the application.
Draw attention to SQL and database management experience gained during the Sunflower Trip internship and freelance projects.
Keep references to AI/ML general as the candidate's primary experience is in full-stack and backend software engineering rather than dedicated AI/ML research.
